PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Live report of every programmable block the Advanced PB Limiter tracks on your servers
PluginData.Description:
A live report for the Advanced PB Limiter Magnetar plugin, the same one its Torch build has on the Reports tab.
Pick a server to see every tracked programmable block and player with run times, peaks, offences, recompiles and memory. Sort and filter the tables, choose how often they refresh, and turn off a block or all of a player's blocks. Viewing needs the view permission, turning blocks off needs permission to control servers.
The limits themselves are set on the server's Plugins page, this plugin adds no settings.
Needs the Advanced PB Limiter Magnetar plugin on the servers. Includes a small companion Magnetar plugin (advancedpblimiter.quasar) that Quasar adds to managed servers; restart servers that were running when this plugin was enabled. Each cluster node shows as its own server.
